problems: Convention clash (reviewer's, still open): the RSFSR and Soviet republic dossiers use union republics as counterparts while the USSR uses the USSR; the USSR records German-held land as loss/gain while the RSFSR records it as occupation by nazi-germany. The orchestrator should choose one convention for eu-17.

Page budgets exceeded for the repair: ukrainian-people-s-republic now cites 7 pages (budget 1-2), union-of-soviet-socialist-republics 24 (budget 9); each extra page was opened to date a finding or a thin item.

Disagreements with the reviewer: Eastern Galicia loss dated 1919-7 from the Polish-Ukrainian War page (confidence 3) instead of the UPR page (which puts the Galician Army's defeat in late May 1919); the Karelian Isthmus gain kept at 1944-9 (armistice) although the Red Army entered Vyborg on 20 June 1944; the Przemysl area is not named on the Territorial changes of Poland page (loss confidence 2); the Soviet zone's start is 2 August 1945 on the Soviet occupation zone page against June (occupation's start) in allied-occupied-germany, June kept for the mirror.
The UPR 1919-3 loss region is the Soviet /ledger/10 region and overlaps the Podillia pocket the UPR held from July 1919; the Soviet dossier has no matching loss.
